prompt:
Subject:
Walking by the light blue pool

Main Figure:
A full-body photograph of a woman in the center of the frame, captured from behind at a bright tropical-style poolside. She is walking barefoot wearing a light blue string bikini, with both hands resting on the side ties of her waist.

Person and Expression:
A profile view with her back to the camera and her face turned toward the lower right of the frame. A quiet expression with downcast eyes, a slender nose, and closed, pale lips. Her bright skin sparkles with fine droplets of water. Her brown hair is in wet, loose waves hanging down to her shoulder blades, with short bangs and hair around the face following her right cheek.

Clothing and Pose:
A vibrant light turquoise triangle bikini swimsuit. Thin strings tied at the back of the neck, a thin under-bust string across the back, and bottoms tied with thin ribbons at both hips. The subject is stepping forward with her left leg, lifting her right heel, and slightly bending both elbows to rest her fingertips on the side ties.

Background and Lighting:
In the left foreground, a white pillar and a wooden white lounger with a light blue cushion. In the far right, a blue pool; the background features deep green palm plants and a white building. Hard summer direct sunlight hits from above, with shadows and reflections of the legs stretching onto the wet stone floor.

Composition and Camera:
A 3:4 vertical full-body portrait from behind, captured at a horizontal eye level slightly higher than the waist, with the entire figure from head to toes within the frame. The person occupies a large part of the center, with the pool positioned in the upper right. Focused on the back and the swimsuit, with a medium depth of field softly blurring the background.

Texture and Style:
A bright, photorealistic live-action photograph. High-definition rendering of water droplets, skin, the thin fabric of the swimsuit, wet stone, wood, and plants, primarily in white and turquoise.

Negative:
Do not face forward; do not omit the waist ties.
